comment: Approved differences between the legacy transcripts and the settlement or payment service. A scenario listed here is judged against its 'expected' block instead of the transcript and is reported as CHANGED (<change>) by make parity; anything else is still a FAIL. Each entry must name a docs/changes/CHG-nnn record (ADR-001 and ADR-002, 'Behaviour freeze'). An entry whose scenario has no transcript (no recording of it exists and transcripts/ is written only by make capture) carries its own 'request' block and is replayed from it after the transcripts.
transcript_rules_comment: Which SPEC-SETTLE-001 / SPEC-PAY-001 rules each settlement or payment transcript is evidence for, taken from the 'Observed:' lines of the spec. tools/traceability.py reads this to put transcripts and their parity verdicts next to each rule. An entry without a version (SETTLE-R05) applies to every version of that rule; a version-qualified entry (SETTLE-R06 (v2)) applies to that version only.

approved_differences.summary: A non-blank, unparseable deductible is a validation error instead of the error screen
An amount above the claim's latest settlement amount is a validation error and writes no PAYMENT row
